title: Pneumatic Cylinder - Acting Velocity
description: Calculate pneumatic cylinder acting velocity based on volume flow and piston area.

components.content:
# Pneumatic Cylinder - Acting Velocity

Velocity of a pneumatic cylinder can be calculated using:

**s = 28.8 q / A**

Where:
- **s** = velocity (inches/sec)
- **q** = volume flow (cubic feet/min)
- **A** = piston area (square inches)
